notes: Seeded-defect evals built from real documentation misses. Each needs github.com access. They run as offline cases: the live checks some assertions reward use the public play.im.dhis2.org instances, a deliberate exception to the AGENTS.md rule for this skill (see SKILL.md pass F), so no provisioned instance is requested. Run with and without the skill; a good run catches the defect AND reports verdict, evidence and scope. Every eval also carries the three shared assertions at the end of its list.

evals.prompt: Here's the program indicator functions table from our docs: d2:addDays, d2:ceil, d2:condition, d2:count, d2:countIfValue, d2:countIfZeroPos, d2:daysBetween, d2:floor, d2:hasValue, d2:left, d2:length, d2:modulus, d2:monthsBetween, d2:oizp, d2:right, d2:round, d2:split, d2:substring, d2:validatePattern, d2:weeksBetween, d2:yearsBetween, d2:zing, d2:zpvc, d2:zScoreHFA, d2:zScoreWFA, d2:zScoreWFH, d2:minutesBetween, d2:relationshipCount, d2:extractDataMatrixValue. Can you check it's right against 2.43?
evals.expected_output: Enumerates the program indicator registration map (ExpressionMapBuilder + ParserUtils common set) at the 2.43 branch, diffs both directions, and reports functions present in source but missing from the table (for example d2:maxValue, d2:minValue, contains, containsItems, removeZeros, avg/count/max/min/stddev/sum/variance) as well as any listed function that is not registered.
assertions: Uses dhis2-core registration maps at the 2.43 branch as evidence, not the ANTLR grammar or other docs
Runs direction B (source → page) and lists functions that are registered but missing from the table
Names at least three of: d2:maxValue, d2:minValue, contains, containsItems, removeZeros
States explicitly that both directions were run
Each finding has a verdict from the skill's verdict set and cites file and branch
Does not run git inside someone else's working checkout (clones into a scratch directory)
Reports that the list omits the common registered functions (for example if, isNull, greatest/least, contains) and not only d2: functions
Sends the section's worked examples through a validator (or reads them) and reports broken examples, or lists this as not done
Reports which of the listed functions are program-rule-only and rejected for program indicators at 2.43 (grader verifies the list against the 2.43 registration maps)
The reply itself (not only a side file) lists every check that was blocked, skipped or limited in scope
No factual claim in the reply is contradicted by the run's own evidence or by independent verification
Does not claim register or file updates that were not actually written
